exams.name: Home Inspector Written Exam
exams.notes: The board may recommend use of a national entity's exam; if used, a Washington-specific section must be included.
exams.jurisdiction: state (department-administered, with option to use national entity exam)
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure must pass an exam that is psychometrically valid, reliable, and legally defensible by the state. The exam is to be developed, maintained, and administered by the department.

interval_years.quote: Licenses are issued for a term of two years and expire on the applicant's second birthday following issuance of the license.

required.quote: Each applicant for license renewal shall complete at least twenty-four hours of instruction in courses approved by the board every two years.

hours_per_period.quote: at least twenty-four hours of instruction in courses approved by the board every two years

period_years.quote: at least twenty-four hours of instruction in courses approved by the board every two years

available.quote: Persons licensed as home inspectors in other states may become licensed as home inspectors under this chapter as long as the other state has licensing requirements that meet or exceed those required under this chapter and the person seeking a license under this chapter passes the Washington portion of the exam

requirements.value: Other state's licensing requirements must meet or exceed Washington's requirements, and applicant must pass the Washington portion of the exam.
requirements.quote: the other state has licensing requirements that meet or exceed those required under this chapter and the person seeking a license under this chapter passes the Washington portion of the exam under RCW 18.280.080

exists.quote: The state home inspector advisory licensing board is created. The board consists of seven members appointed by the director, who shall advise the director concerning the administration of this chapter.

name.quote: "Board" means the home inspector advisory licensing board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession or operation of the person's business, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining, renewing, or reinstating a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining or renewing a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is false, deceptive, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice resulting in or creating risk of harm to another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice that results in harm or damage to another or that creates an unreasonable risk of harm or damage to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The suspension, revocation, or restriction of a license to engage in any business or profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplinary authority in the course of an investigation, audit, or inspection authorized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplinary authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplinary authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provisions of this chapter or applicable chapters or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of this chapter or the chapters specified in RCW 18.235.020(2) or any rules made by the disciplinary authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice or operate a business or profession when a license is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice or operate a business or profession when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice or operation of a business or profession beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice or operation of a business or profession beyond the scope of practice or operation as defined by law or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise or oversee auxiliary staff, whether employees or contractors, to the extent that consumers may be harmed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to adequately supervise or oversee auxiliary staff, whether employees or contractors, to the extent that consumers may be harmed or damaged

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession or operation of the person's business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary action by willful misrepresentation, threats, harassment, or financial inducements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary action by willful misrepresentation of facts before the disciplinary authority or its authorized representatives, or by the use of threats or harassment against any consumer or witness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlicensed practice as defined in RCW 18.235.010
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unlicensed practice as defined in RCW 18.235.010.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certification by DSHS as a person not in compliance with a child support order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The director shall immediately suspend the license of a person who has been certified pursuant to RCW 74.20A.320 by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a child support order.

definition_quote.value: A person licensed under this chapter is responsible for performing a visual and noninvasive inspection of the following readily accessible systems and components of a home and reporting on the general condition of those systems and components at the time of the inspection in his or her written report: The roof, foundation, exterior, heating system, air conditioning system, structure, plumbing and electrical systems, and other aspects of the home as may be identified by the board.

value: performing work other than home inspection-related consultation on an inspected home within one year of the date of the report
prohibited_conflict_of_interest_practice.quote: A licensed home inspector, or other licensed home inspectors or employees who work for the same company or for any company in which the home inspector has a financial interest, shall not, from the time of the inspection until one year from the date of the report, perform any work other than home inspection-related consultation on the home upon which he or she has performed a home inspection.

standards_of_practice_body.quote: The standards of practice to be developed by the board will be used as the minimum standards for an inspection.

value: national entity (as recommended by the board)
approved_exam_bodies.quote: The board shall recommend to the director whether to use an exam that is prepared by a national entity.
